value: The campaign continued into the Ruins and the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Beyond the qiraji armies lay C'Thun, the deeper threat against which the preparations had been gathered. Victory there gave the opened gate its purpose: the company had not restored a key merely to release what waited behind the wall. It had restored a way to reach that danger. The victory brought this campaign to its close, after a long road from the bronze dragon’s vigil. The scepter's legacy joins the losses of the first war to the collective labor of the second.
